name: Mekong CLI
model: Open-core dual-license: MIT community core (self-hosted PLG wedge) plus managed cloud control plane and signed-license enterprise tiers (hypothesis until a signed license gate exists and paid retention is measured)
target_arr: $1M ARR within 12 months (aspirational, not a forecast)
icp: Hypothesis: technically capable solo founders or very small teams with a recurring business or software workflow that is costly or error-prone today.
moat: Potential differentiation: local-first execution, provider-neutral runtime boundaries, composable CLI workflows, and governance-aware execution. Defensibility is unproven.

agents.founder: CEO: strategy, customer discovery, approvals, and weekly review
agents.product: PM: interview synthesis, workflow scope, and success criteria
agents.engineering: ENG: reliability, verification, provider handling, and cost measurement
agents.revenue: AE/CMO: approved research, content drafts, and founder-led experiments
agents.operations: OPS: support, incidents, and product evidence
agents.governance: Risk: source tracking, claims, permissions, privacy, and audit preparation

okrs: Months 1-3: validate one ICP and one recurring workflow with 15 interviews and up to three design partners; document evidence and counter-evidence.
Months 4-6: if pilot evidence supports it, test one paid offer and measure actual payments, activation, repeat use, support effort, refunds, and cost to serve.
Months 7-12: scale only if paid retention, delivery economics, and acquisition repeatability support it; review progress toward the aspirational $1M ARR target.
next_steps: Confirm current product, license, customer, and revenue facts; choose one ICP and recurring workflow.
Decide the Polar.sh checkout removal in src/raas/checkout_router.py. It is a live revenue path, so this is a founder call, not a cleanup task.
Build a signed RAAS_LICENSE_KEY verifier using the canonical BASIC/PREMIUM/ENTERPRISE/MASTER namespace before any paid edition is priced or sold.
Conduct problem interviews and record consented evidence, objections, and disconfirming signals.
Run a bounded design-partner pilot with success criteria, data boundaries, support, and stop conditions.
Test one paid offer only if pilot evidence supports willingness to pay and the license gate can actually enforce it.
Measure activation, repeat use, retention, delivery cost, and risk before scaling.

community.placement: CLI runtime, CapabilityBus, BYOK adapters, tier fallback chain, single-workspace local studio
community.note: Already MIT-licensed in this repository. Functions as the product-led growth top-of-funnel.

cloud.placement: Hosted control plane, MCU credit metering, managed async queues, social publishing adapters

enterprise.placement: White-label subaccount portals, custom domains, cryptographic audit vault, master handover probes

open_core.plg_upgrade_trigger: Hypothesis: a local self-hosted install works free indefinitely; the natural ceiling is concurrency, background scheduling, and multi-seat access, which a single-operator local runtime cannot provide. Quota throttling is not the intended conversion trigger.
open_core.conversion_funnel: Hypothesis: self-hosted workspace portability bundle (export, excluding raw BYOK secrets) imported into a cloud or enterprise instance.

nowpayments_usdt.note: Full IPN settlement implementation, not a stub. Registered in src/gateway.py.

payos_vietqr.note: Vietnam domestic rail for the same tier activation path.

polar_sh.note: Polar.sh rail is decommissioned and returns HTTP 410 Gone. Checkout and activation use Dual-Rail (VietQR + NOWPayments).

definitions.Verified: Backed by live repository files or financial records.
definitions.Hypothesis: Requires customer validation before it can be claimed.
definitions.Target: Directional goal; not a forecast or projection.
